text_blocks.snippet: The primary ICD-10-CM code for a port flush, when performed as a separate service, is Z45.2, which denotes "Encounter for adjustment and management of vascular access device". If the port flush is performed due to an infection or other complication, the appropriate complication code (e.g., T80.211A, T82.514A, T82.594A) should be used in addition to or instead of Z45.2, depending on the specific circumstances.

list.title: Z45.2:
list.snippet: This code is used when a patient comes in specifically for the maintenance or adjustment of a vascular access device, such as a port-a-cath. It is the most appropriate code when the flush is a routine procedure and not due to an active complication.
